card.name: Response and survival wording in cancer dosing
card.fires_on: Small words just before a response or survival term in oncology text, such as 'a' after 'achieve', 'or' between response types, or the P of PFS. It also fires on 'increased' before mortality.

modes.label: Before response terms
modes.description: The word 'a', 'or' or '(' right before CR, CRi or PR after patients achieve a response.
modes.example: For patients who achieve<< a>> CR or a CRi, and/or

modes.label: Progression-free survival
modes.description: The word 'in' or the P of the abbreviation PFS in trial outcome statements.

modes.label: Increased or decreased outcomes
modes.description: A word like 'increased' or the middle of 'Decreased' before mortality or control outcomes.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are about contracts and issuance, so they show no clear link to the text; the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before a tumor response or survival result is named.
